details:
### Vulnerability Condition: Unsafe Shell Command Interpolation & Stdio Injection

**Category**: Command Injection
**CWE**: CWE-78
**Target Tool**: `run_git_status`

#### Vulnerable Behavior
Evaluates unescaped shell strings in stdio execution.

#### Secure Mitigation
Sanitizes paths and executes commands with structured argv arrays.

#### Description
Shell metacharacters in stdio paths allow command execution.
summary: Unsafe Shell Command Interpolation & Stdio Injection in Stdio Launch & Shell Injection Target (mcp-stdio-launch)
